description: The Fraumünster stands on the Münsterhof, on the left bank of the Limmat, and is known from outside by its single slender blue-green spire. The south tower has had no spire since the early eighteenth century, so the church does not read as a pair of towers. The Grossmünster is across the river and is not this subject, and the windows are shown dark, without stained glass. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with no rain.
